content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen works: photo, headline and call bar read in order, though the two hero links below the text are weak underlined anchors that repeat the call bar.","desktopNote":"Desktop first screen is solid, but the hero text links look like plain underlined anchors, and the huge 2006 statistic plus the services list run into long empty bands.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Turn the hero 'Pokličite nas' into one proper primary button and drop the duplicate text links; the header and bottom bar already offer calling.","Tighten the services list: eight items as a plain two-column text list creates slack vertical space on desktop and a very long scroll on phone; use a denser grid or icons.","Shrink the '2006' statistic (it dominates the gold band) and reduce the empty space around the landscape photo on desktop so the gray section doesn't feel hollow."],"blockers":[]}
